#!/sbin/openrc-run

name="inventory-api"
description="Inventory API service (OOM-protected)"
command="/usr/bin/python3"
command_args="/opt/inventory-api/app.py"
command_user="inventory:inventory"
command_background="yes"
pidfile="/run/${RC_SVCNAME}.pid"
output_log="/var/log/inventory-api.log"
error_log="/var/log/inventory-api.log"

depend() {
	need net
	after firewall
}

start_post() {
	local pid tries
	tries=0
	while [ ! -f "${pidfile}" ] && [ ${tries} -lt 20 ]; do
		sleep 0.2
		tries=$((tries + 1))
	done
	if [ -f "${pidfile}" ]; then
		pid=$(cat "${pidfile}")
		# Protect this service from the kernel OOM killer: -1000 makes it
		# ineligible for selection, so an unrelated memory hog is chosen instead.
		if [ -w "/proc/${pid}/oom_score_adj" ]; then
			echo -1000 > "/proc/${pid}/oom_score_adj"
		fi
	fi
}
